description: Carrier scan events emitted as parcels move through the logistics network. Each message represents one physical scan at a carrier facility or delivery point. Multiple messages per order_id track the full parcel journey from pickup to delivery.

fields.tracking: Carrier-assigned parcel tracking number — matches tracking_number in shipping.carrier_status and the tracking field in imazon.orders.events shipped events.
fields.carrier: Logistics carrier that performed this scan (e.g., UPS, FedEx, DHL).
fields.order_id: Imazon order identifier — joins to shipping.carrier_status.order_id in PostgreSQL and to imazon.orders.events.order_id in Kafka.
fields.status: Delivery lifecycle stage at scan time: picked_up | in_transit | out_for_delivery | delivered | delayed.
fields.timestamp: UTC timestamp of the carrier scan event in ISO 8601 format.
fields.location: Human-readable city and state/country where the scan occurred.
fields.reason: Textual explanation for delayed or exception statuses. Present only when status is delayed or exception.
